evidence: The Design introduces no third-party dependency, vendor, managed service, daemon, queue, database, or host scheduler; it explicitly keeps the solution synchronous and Python standard-library-only and reuses incumbent Taskplane and Codex capabilities. The missing knowledge.current_state inventory lowers confidence, but there is no proposed external selection whose duplication, maturity, licence, operational load, lock-in, exit seam, or transitive footprint requires a change.
